issue_context.title: some json functions' return type is not compatible with mysql
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement
some JSON functions' return type is not compatible with MySQL. Particularly on return type, length

review_comments:
Quote and unquote seems to have a decimals of 31 on mysql8.

```
Type:       LONG_BLOB
Collation:  utf8mb4_general_ci (45)
Length:     4294967295
Max_length: 0
Decimals:   31
Flags:      BINARY
```
